description: Réseau Routier départemental - Routes - Département du Cantal - 2020 is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by cg15.fr. Departmental road network, only roads under the jurisdiction of the Department of Cantal. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Departmental Road Network - Routes - Department of Cantal - 2020" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include route départementale, routes. The listing shows 2020-06-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
